subject: food-technology
title: Kneading & Proving
welcome_lead: Build gluten with kneading, let yeast work with proving.
meta_desc: KS3 food: kneading, proving and bread structure.
final_note: Time and warmth turn dough into bread.

concepts.def: Punching air out for second prove.
Outer brown layer of baked bread.

walkthroughs.body_html: Knead for about 10 minutes. Push, fold, turn, push again. Kneading stretches and aligns the gluten so dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Let dough prove in a warm place until doubled in size — usually 1 hour. Yeast makes CO2; gluten traps the gas in tiny pockets.
Punch out the air (knock back), shape the loaf, let prove again 30-45 min. Then bake at 200°C until golden and hollow-sounding when tapped.
